title: Gee Sing Tsoo

page_data.en:
SPECIAL BRANCH REGISTRY.
File No. L O 218

SUBJECT

Report re movements through S'hai-Nanking R-way
Station : foreigners, Chin. Soldiers etc.
Name mentioned
Gee Sing-tsoo, involved in Chao-Ho incident

Memorandum.
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 218
Date 2/4/16

FROM THE POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL,
Central. STATION,
Shanghai, 29th March 1916

To Chief Det Insp.
C.I.D.

Sir
Gee Sing Tsoo 祁性初 the person referred to in the attached
report, was arrested in the Sinza District some time ago and charged
with complicity in the Chao-Ho incident. He was tried at the Mixed
Court and handed over in the usual wayto the Military Authorities.
The file, with his statement and other details has been returned to
Sinza.

He was Charged
with escaping from
prison in Nankin
as well as it was
on his charge but he
was handed over
MA

Your Obedient Servant
WB newport
D.S.I.
page_data.zh:
特别处档案室。
档案编号 L O 218

事由

关于经上海—南京铁路车站通行人员（外国人、中国士兵等）的报告
提及姓名
祁性初（Gee Sing-tsoo），涉及赵和事件

备忘录。
刑事侦缉处。
情报官登记处
第 218 号
日期 1916年4月2日

发自警务处，
工部局，
中央巡捕房，
上海，1916年3月29日

致刑事侦缉处首席督察长

先生：
附件报告中所提及之祁性初（Gee Sing Tsoo），此前在闸北地区被捕，并被指控参与赵和事件。他已在会审公廨受审，并按惯例移交军事当局。
包含其供词及其他细节的案卷已退回闸北。

他被指控
从南京监狱越狱，
此指控亦在其名下，
但他已被移交
军事当局

您忠实的仆人
W.B. Newport
副督察长

page_data.en:
Form 2 34
Shanghai Municipal Police.
West Loungkow. Station.
28 - 3 - 1916
REPORT ON Shanghai Nanking Railway Station
Made by J.W. Spence S.P. Forwarded by

Sir,
I beg to forward the following list of Foreigners
arrived at and departed from Shanghai; via the
Shanghai Nanking Railway Station on the 28th inst.

Arrivals 11 Men 4 Women
Deps 15 " 2 "

It is reported that 180 Recruit Soldiers from "Anhwui"
arrived at Shanghai by "transport train" at 5 pm today,
they left for Woosung by the 6 pm train.
This evening a Revolutionary named "Gee Suip Soo"
was brought from the Arsenal by launch, escorted by
10 Soldiers and an Officer, he was taken to Nanking by
the 11 pm train from Shanghai.
Nothing further unusual was reported during the day.

（印：I.O / When in / want of）

To C.C.D Supdt
C.I.D.
Central

Sam Sir.
Yours Obediently
J.W. Spence
S.P.
page_data.zh:
表格 2 34
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
西老闸捕房。
1916年3月28日
关于上海南京路火车站的报告
由警员 J.W. Spence 制作，呈报人

先生：
谨此呈报下列于本月28日经由上海南京路火车站抵达及离开上海的外国人名单。

抵达：男性11人，女性4人
离境：男性15人，女性2人

据报，180名来自“安徽”的新兵于今日下午5时乘“运兵专列”抵达上海，他们于下午6时乘车前往吴淞。
今晚，一名名为“Gee Suip Soo”（音译）的革命党人由汽艇从兵工厂押送而来，由10名士兵和一名军官护送，他于晚上11时乘火车从上海前往南京。
当日未报告其他异常情况。

（印章：I.O / When in / want of）

致刑事侦缉处总监
刑事侦缉处
中央

尊敬的先生。
您忠实的仆人
J.W. Spence
警员
